name: Glass channel analytics
oneLiner: a studio analytics card on glass: the realtime views number races up while a bar chart ticks in left to right, the series slides one bar as a hot new bar grows at Now, then the top video row lifts out of the list with its count ticking up and a green delta chip
say: when the speaker opens their analytics or says a video is taking off right now ('look at the realtime views', 'this one is still climbing'): the new bar lands on 'right now', the top row lifts as they name the video
